# Tests the Fast workflow (.github/workflows/fast.yml) leaves out.
#
# Fast holds a budget (push 30 s, pull request 60 s, on the job clock). A test
# that is too slow for it, needs a tool the runner lacks, or flakes comes out
# here the day it is found, with its reason. Fix it and delete its line.
#
# One entry per line, its reason after the #:
#   <path>          a test file Fast never runs
#   push: <path>    a test file Fast runs on pull requests only
#   test: <name>    one test Fast skips by its exact name, wherever it is

# These launch Playwright's Chromium, which Fast does not install.
packages/capture/src/font-audit.test.ts    # Chromium
packages/capture/src/probe.test.ts         # Chromium
packages/drivers/src/dom.test.ts           # Chromium
packages/drivers/src/api.test.ts           # Chromium
packages/agents/src/api-replay.test.ts     # Chromium
packages/drivers/src/recording.test.ts     # Chromium and ffmpeg, 3 of its 4 tests

# Over 3 s each on the runner: pull requests run them, pushes do not.
push: packages/agents/src/review.test.ts         # 16 s
push: packages/agents/src/fixer-patrol.test.ts   # 5.6 s
push: packages/agents/src/replay.test.ts         # 3.1 s

# In review.test.ts, which pull requests run.
test: records the replay on both builds, and shows both recordings side by side with the full videos   # ffmpeg
test: checks status and body on both builds with no model, and shows both HTTP transcripts as terminal recordings   # Chromium
test: replays the same requests on both builds, and ignores generated ids, times and key order   # Chromium
# In packages/dashboard/src/agents.test.ts.
test: picks up .bugpatrol created after start   # flaky: waits a fixed 700 ms for a file watcher
